Class Notifications

java.lang.Object
masroofy.core.Notifications
public final class Notifications extends Object
Sends push notifications using ntfy (HTTP POST).

Defaults target: https://ntfy.sh/masroofyXX where XX is a 2-digit id stored in settings (or derived from the machine when missing).

Configuration via environment variables:

  • NTFY_ENABLED (default true)
  • NTFY_BASE_URL (default https://ntfy.sh)
  • NTFY_TOPIC (optional override)

Failures should never crash the app; sending is best-effort.
